name: Advertising Dashboard
job: Create an uncluttered advertising dashboard block that manages campaigns, channel and review status, poster QR destinations, private asset uploads, and file downloads; integrate it into the existing BulkBite app shell as a supporting workflow.
incomingHandoff: A permitted staff member needs one place to find a campaign, check its review state and destination, or attach the latest artwork and print pack.
outgoingHandoff: The campaign holds private downloadable assets, explicit channel rules, the exact poster QR or digital destination, and a review state without publishing anything automatically.
responsiveBehaviour: Use a two-column campaign and detail workspace on wide screens, then stack filters, campaign list, details, and editing controls into one reading column on mobile without hiding file access or status.

layoutContract.containment: A compact header and status summary lead into filters and a bounded campaign-to-assets workspace. Editing stays in normal flow and never hides the campaign library.

surfaceContract.contentSeparation: Semantic component surfaces group campaign records while spacing continues to define hierarchy.
surfaceContract.rule: No primitive surface is mounted. Use only selected component surfaces and semantic theme tokens.

motionContract.justification: Campaign records, destinations, status, and files must remain immediately readable; provider control feedback is sufficient.
